remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3-story end unit offering the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience. Featuring 3 spacious bedrooms, 3.5 modern bathrooms, and a 2-car garage, this home is ideal for those seeking low-maintenance luxury living. Enjoy gleaming hardwood floors throughout, a bright and open floor plan, kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, washer/dryer in the unit, walk-in closet and plenty of storage. Perfectly located for commuters, this home is just steps from the historic SoNo district, where you'll find dining, shopping, entertainment, and the waterfront. Walk to the train station and enjoy easy access to major highways. Don't miss this opportunity to own a stylish and spacious home in one of Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods!
